package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type LessonRevisionRepoPG struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) GetRevision(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	var raw []byte
	if err := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT definition FROM lesson_revision WHERE id=$1`, id).Scan(&raw); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	var value domain.LessonRevision
	err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &value)
	return &value, err
}
func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) GetPolicy(ctx context.Context, id string) ([]domain.LessonActivity, error) {
	var raw []byte
	err := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT activities FROM lesson_completion_policy WHERE lesson_id=$1`, id).Scan(&raw)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var value []domain.LessonActivity
	err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &value)
	return value, err
}
func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) SetPolicy(ctx context.Context, id string, a []domain.LessonActivity) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(a)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO lesson_completion_policy(lesson_id,activities) VALUES($1,$2) ON CONFLICT(lesson_id) DO UPDATE SET activities=EXCLUDED.activities,updated_at=now()`, id, raw)
	return mapPgError(err)
}
func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) StoreRevision(ctx context.Context, hash string, v domain.LessonRevision) (*domain.LessonRevision, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_, err = getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO lesson_revision(id,lesson_id,content_hash,definition,created_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) ON CONFLICT(lesson_id,content_hash) DO NOTHING`, v.LessonRevisionID, v.LessonID, hash, raw, v.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapPgError(err)
	}
	var stored []byte
	err = getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT definition FROM lesson_revision WHERE lesson_id=$1 AND content_hash=$2`, v.LessonID, hash).Scan(&stored)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	err = json.Unmarshal(stored, &v)
	return &v, err
}

// Repeatable-read snapshots prevent mixed content when authors edit concurrently.
type LessonRevisionTxPG struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (r LessonRevisionTxPG) WithTx(ctx repository.Context, fn func(repository.Context) error) error {
	tx, err := r.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, txKey{}, tx)
	if err = fn(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

var _ repository.LessonRevisionRepository = LessonRevisionRepoPG{}

func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) GetGeneratedReceipt(ctx context.Context, key string) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error) {
	var raw []byte
	err := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT lessons FROM generated_course_revision_receipt WHERE idempotency_key=$1`, key).Scan(&raw)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var value []domain.GeneratedLessonBinding
	err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &value)
	return value, err
}
func (r LessonRevisionRepoPG) StoreGeneratedReceipt(ctx context.Context, key string, bindings []domain.GeneratedLessonBinding) ([]domain.GeneratedLessonBinding, error) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(bindings)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	_, err = getRunner(ctx, r.Pool).Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO generated_course_revision_receipt(idempotency_key,lessons) VALUES($1,$2) ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING`, key, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return r.GetGeneratedReceipt(ctx, key)
}
